name: Drowned (lesser)

chop.note: P_safe = the 76-frame recovery. A straight sword R1 has Ps 25 f@60 (RI-CMB02 §A), so this window is punishable with 51 frames of slack.

provenance.frame_data: Inherits INFANTRY frame data from inf_trash unchanged — a summon is a body in the fight, not a new moveset. W1-05 owns movesets; this statblock exists so that `bind_lesser`/`bind_greater` have something to put in listEntities(), which is the delta RI-MAG06 §B names for both.
provenance.ai: `none` — a summon does not act in wave 1. RI-MAG06's row for these two effects is `listEntities()`: a creature exists that did not. What it DOES is W1-12's (enemy/ally action selection), and claiming otherwise would be a fabricated measurement.
provenance.vfx: RI-MAG05 §A3 L3: over ~40 f@60 the water bulges, something inside it takes shape, and it hauls itself out. There is no flash at any point.

_armour_rating_note: Seam S19's consuming system for `corrode` (RI-MAG06 §B: "the rating falls"). A flat subtraction from every incoming damage number, applied in combat/resolve.js at the one site damage is computed. It was 0 everywhere in wave 1, which meant `corrode` had nothing to corrode and measured NOT_OBSERVED. Provisional: RI-CMB01 owns armour as a fight quantity and may re-derive every figure here.
